text:
Type: areca palm in a nursery pot
Use: adding greenery and softness to a corner or beside a sofa; living room, home office, dining room
Style: bohemian, coastal, Scandinavian
Materials: live plant with feathery fronds, terracotta-colored plastic grower pot
Colors: fresh bright green, yellow-green stems, terracotta orange pot
Shape: tall upright clump of slender cane stems with arching feathery fronds, full and airy, large floor plant
Feel: fresh, lush, tropical, relaxed
Goes with: woven baskets, rattan, light wood, white walls; bohemian, coastal or Scandinavian rooms
